subject: science
concept: Applying Earth and space knowledge to a real-world scenario using the student's interest profile
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.concrete: Student solves a realistic scenario requiring knowledge of day/night, seasons, landforms, or resource care
exercise.pictorial: Student illustrates their solution to the scenario
exercise.abstract: Student explains their reasoning in a short written response

misconception_flags: gives a correct final answer but cannot explain the Earth/space reasoning behind it

interest_binding: scenario generated fresh from student's stated interest profile
